findingDetails.title: Symlinked track writes a new packet outside specs
findingDetails.case: An existing specs/linked symlink points to another directory and create.sh runs with --track linked.
findingDetails.evidence: validate_track_value checks the spelling only, then mkdir uses the symlinked path; the shipped test asserts creation in the outside target.
findingDetails.userImpact: A scaffold can write outside the required specs root and phase 010 containment is unfulfilled.
findingDetails.recommendation: Resolve the track root before mkdir and reject targets outside the resolved specs root; update the symlink test.
findingDetails.claim: The shipped create path accepts a track that resolves outside specs despite phase 010 requiring rejection.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Looked for a later resolved-path containment guard before packet creation; the positive symlink test confirms the opposite behavior.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The implementation intentionally allows symlinked tracks for another repository, but that choice conflicts with the phase requirement.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A documented amendment to the phase requirement explicitly exempts symlinked tracks.

findingDetails.title: Mixed fence markers hide a later unfilled value token
findingDetails.case: A v2.3 Complete doc contains ~~~md, then a literal ``` line inside that fence, then ~~~ closing it, then an unfilled value token in prose.
findingDetails.evidence: Both scanners toggle fence state on either marker without matching the opener. The shell helper returned no marker for this sequence, while it reported 1 token for the same prose line alone.
findingDetails.userImpact: A Complete packet can pass the placeholder gate with an unfilled value token.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Orchestrator .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/lib/validation/orchestrator.ts:814 and shell helper .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/cli/rules/check-placeholders.sh:74 share the toggle; the phase 003/010 token guarantee covers both.
findingDetails.recommendation: Track fence delimiter and length, closing only on a matching Markdown fence; add the mixed-fence negative case to the parity test.
findingDetails.claim: The token-gate scanner misses a bare value token after a valid tilde fence containing a literal backtick fence line.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked the shell helper on the mixed-fence sequence and a single-token control; the former returned no row and the latter returned 1 token.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: If the doc grammar forbade mixed fence text, the case would be invalid, but the templates and validator claim general Markdown fenced-code handling.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A documented, enforced spec-doc grammar bans backtick delimiter text inside tilde fences.
